title: Three-Reggeon exchange in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM to leading logarithmic accuracy
summary: We study eight-point amplitudes in the planar $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills theory in multi-Regge kinematics in the Mandelstam region that receives contributions from both two- and three-Reggeon exchange. We use an effective field theory approach to compute the leading contribution from three-Reggeon exchange, and we explicitly evaluate the relevant diagrams up to four loops.
